plans.starter: Starter · £99 + £25/mo. Your colours, type and logo on this design: the salon and the first appointment as a card in your words, one Request that opens a quiet sheet (the wedding date, how many are coming, the designers to have ready) and sends it on WhatsApp, the designers you stock with their price bands, and a Plan your visit page with every question.
plans.plus: Plus · £199 + £30/mo. Up to five pages including home: every gown with the finder (silhouette, neckline, sleeve, designer) and "Ask to try", two or three gowns full screen on the home page, trunk shows and sample sales with a waiting list, fittings, alterations and veils, a brides page with their words, gift vouchers and your team.
plans.signature: Signature · £349 + £35/mo. Up to 20 pages, plus the showpieces: the gown diary from one wedding date to the whole year, added to her calendar; the mirror, every gown from every side; the shortlist she sends you and shares with her mother; and something made just for your salon.

gate.plus: Starter is a full home page plus Plan your visit. Plus adds up to four more pages, like this one: the gowns with the finder, fittings and veils, brides and gift vouchers.
gate.signature: Signature adds the showpieces: the gown diary, the mirror and the shortlist.
